nonPaletteValues.name: hero-name-metal

nonPaletteValues.name: mask-partial
nonPaletteValues.purpose: Alpha-mask stop meaning 35% shown, at 12% of the hero portrait left fade. Coverage only.

nonPaletteValues.name: hero-bg-exposure
nonPaletteValues.value: opacity .24; filter saturate(.75) brightness(.92); shades radial-gradient(ellipse at 50% 42%, rgba(10,27,56,.15), rgba(10,27,56,.72) 78%) + linear-gradient(to bottom, rgba(10,27,56,.65), rgba(10,27,56,0) 28%, rgba(10,27,56,.35) 68%, #0A1B38 100%)
nonPaletteValues.purpose: Office facade behind the hero at low exposure; shades are navy-900 at alpha.

nonPaletteValues.name: justice-light
nonPaletteValues.purpose: Amber light behind the Lady Justice statue; statue filter saturate(1.1) contrast(1.06).

nonPaletteValues.name: tilt-glare
nonPaletteValues.value: radial-gradient(circle at var(--gx) var(--gy), rgba(255,238,210,.28), rgba(255,238,210,0) 55%)
nonPaletteValues.purpose: Warm light that follows the pointer over tilting images. Light, not a palette colour.

display.purpose: Practice-area section titles; statement headings use the same face at clamp(2.4rem, 5.2vw, 5.25rem) beside the statue and clamp(2.6rem, 6vw, 5.75rem) in the closing band; the scroll-lit office statement at clamp(2.1rem, 4.4vw, 4.25rem).

subtitle-lg.purpose: Italic Pale Straw hero practice line from 1024px.

figure.purpose: Amber statistics with tabular lining numerals; the preloader counter uses the same treatment at 3rem, amber 0.7.

shadows.name: slab-lift-hover
shadows.purpose: Primary button on hover, with a 2px rise.

motion.name: ease-out
motion.purpose: All CSS state transitions (0.4s buttons, 0.45s rows, menu and cursor, 0.5s header and glare, 0.6s clause phrase indent, 0.7s clause sweep and drawn rule), FAQ height (0.6s) and the WhatsApp pulse.

motion.name: gsap-expo-out
motion.purpose: Entrances: masked word reveals (1.3s, stagger 0.04), hero name characters (1.4s, stagger 0.035), fades (1.2s, y 24 to 40px), header hide and return (0.6s). Statue entrance (2s, yPercent 12, scale 1.08) and CTA cut-out (1.8s, yPercent 14).

motion.name: gsap-expo-in-out
motion.purpose: Drawn rules (scaleX from left, 1.8s), image clip-path reveals (1.6s) and the preloader wipe (1.1s).

motion.name: stroke-draw
motion.purpose: Monogram strokes drawn via stroke-dashoffset, 0.9 to 1.8s, stagger 0.09 to 0.15; the preloader counter 0 to 100 over 1.3s.

motion.name: pointer-follow
motion.purpose: Cursor ring 0.5s (dot 0.08s), magnetic pull 0.6s, tilt 0.8s, hero portrait 1.2s (x 11px, rotationY 3.5deg), hero name 1.4s (17px), statue 1.4s (rotationY 5deg, x 15px), halo 1.8s, hero facade 2s (13px).

motion.name: magnetic-return
motion.purpose: Magnetic buttons and the WhatsApp float springing home on leave. The only elastic curve in the system.

motion.name: letter-hop
motion.purpose: Hero name letters on hover; no colour change, so the metallic fill stays.

motion.name: wa-pulse
motion.value: 2.8s ease-out infinite, scale 1 to 1.8, opacity 0.8 to 0
motion.purpose: Pulse ring around the floating WhatsApp button.

motion.name: marquee
motion.value: 38s linear loop; timeScale up to 7x from scroll velocity, sign from scroll direction, easing back over 1.4s

motion.name: scrub
motion.purpose: Reading progress (0.3), timeline track and progress (0.8), scroll-lit words (opacity 0.16 to 1, stagger 0.1), hero parallax (facade yPercent 12, portrait, name, halo), statue (y -60, rotate -1.5deg), facade image parallax.

motion.name: smooth-scroll
motion.purpose: Smooth scroll; stopped during the preloader and while the mobile menu is open.

motion.name: motion-policy
motion.value: motion-ready class set in head; removed if GSAP has not started within 3s
motion.purpose: Content renders in its final state without JS or libraries. Motion runs regardless of prefers-reduced-motion, by the owner's decision.

motion.name: pointer-gate
motion.purpose: Cursor, magnetism, tilt, glare, hero and statue follow, letter hops.

narrative.overview:
A deep navy field runs edge to edge and is never broken by a white page. Structure on it is drawn, not built. Thin amber and ivory hairlines divide, underline and track progress. They share their straight-stroke vocabulary with the EG monogram, whose six strokes are redrawn as SVG lines that draw themselves when they appear. Type does the monumental work. Her name stands in tall Anton capitals with a cast-metal finish. Bodoni Moda at very large sizes carries section titles and the client's own phrasing of a problem. Outfit carries everything that must read calmly for an older visitor on a phone.

Density is low and the sections form bands. Each one is a full-width navy band, one step lighter or darker than its neighbour, with generous vertical padding. Amber is the only warm, saturated colour, and the lawyer's blazer in the hero photograph is the only red. Photography sits low in the field: the office facade dimmed behind the hero, and cut-outs (the lawyer twice, a bronze Lady Justice once) that feather into the navy. Motion is exponential and editorial: a drawn-monogram preloader, masked word reveals, drawn strokes, words that light as you read and a pinned timeline. On a mouse, the page also answers the hand. An amber ring follows the pointer, actions pull toward it, and figures and photographs turn under it. The page is complete and legible without any of it.

The system rejects the law-firm default of gavels and rows of equal boxed service cards. Content that would otherwise be cards is set as ruled rows or as stages on a timeline. The one classical emblem is a bronze Lady Justice, used once, to introduce the practice areas.
keyCharacteristics: Navy ground in four tonal steps; sections band by tone, not by borders or shadows.
Amber is the single accent: actions, hairlines, figures, monogram, pointer, the light behind cut-outs.
Anton capitals for her name, Bodoni Moda at monumental scale for titles, an Outfit body in ivory.
Hairline rules, never boxes; square corners, with circles reserved for the WhatsApp float, the contact buttons and the pointer layer.
Drawn, masked, expo-out motion plus a fine-pointer interaction layer, with a full no-JS fallback.

rules.name: The One Red Rule
rules.body: Red exists only in the hero photograph. No token, rule, button or illustration is red.

rules.name: The One Metal Rule
rules.body: Amber is the only accent hue. Hierarchy within it comes from alpha and from the amber / amber-soft pair, never from a second accent. The hero name's cast-metal finish is a material, not a second accent, and it appears nowhere else.

rules.name: The Banded Ground Rule
rules.body: Sections separate by stepping the navy tone (950 / 900 / 850 / 800), not by cards, borders around blocks or shadows.

rules.name: The Cast Name Rule
rules.body: The hero name is the only Anton and the only gradient-filled text in the system. The owner chose the finish from a reference image. It is sanctioned for the hero name alone and does not license gradient text anywhere else.

rules.name: The Italic Voice Rule
rules.body: Bodoni italic marks the client-facing voice: the hero subtitle, the marquee of practice areas and the list of who the office defends, separated by upright amber slashes.

rules.name: The Tabular Registration Rule
rules.body: OAB numbers, figures and counters always use tabular lining numerals.

rules.name: The Drawn Not Built Rule
rules.body: Structure is a 1px line, not a container. If a block needs separating, rule it; do not box it.

rules.name: The Feathered Cut-out Rule
rules.body: Every cut-out figure stands on the field, not in a frame. Its foot fades out through an alpha mask, and a radial amber light, never a box, sits behind it.

rules.name: The Pointer Layer Rule
rules.body: The cursor, magnetism, tilt, glare, figure follow and letter hops exist only on a fine, hovering pointer. Touch users get the same page with scroll-driven motion alone, and nothing they need is hidden behind a hover.

dos: Do separate sections by stepping the navy ground (950, 900, 850, 800) and separate content with 1px hairlines.
Do keep amber as the only accent and vary its strength by alpha; put Pale Straw (`amber-soft`) beside text.

Do set the hero name in Anton capitals with its metallic finish. Set titles and the client's own words in Bodoni Moda at weight 400 with negative tracking. Set running prose in Outfit at 1.06rem or larger. Single secondary lines step down to 0.92 to 0.98rem, and only the wordmark capitals and the cursor label go to 0.7rem.
Do stand cut-out figures on the field, with a feathered alpha-mask foot and a radial amber light behind them.
Do keep photographs behind type at low exposure (the hero facade at 0.24 opacity under navy shades).
Do route every action to WhatsApp through the amber slab, the line button, a clause row, a contact button or a drawn-underline link.

Do animate with the expo-out curve `cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1)`: masked word reveals, rules drawn from the left, monogram strokes drawn in sequence. Use elastic.out(1, 0.4) only for the magnetic return.

Do ship the final, fully visible state in the markup. Hidden start states apply only under the `motion-ready` class, which is removed if GSAP and ScrollTrigger have not started within 3s. At the owner's request, motion runs whether or not the visitor's system asks for reduced motion.
Do gate every pointer effect behind `(hover: hover) and (pointer: fine)`.
Do set OAB registrations, figures and counters with tabular lining numerals.
donts: Don't introduce red anywhere outside the hero photograph.
Don't use gavel imagery, and don't repeat the Lady Justice statue; she appears once, in the practice-areas intro.
Don't set services as a row of equal boxed cards; use ruled rows or the timeline.
Don't clip gradients to text anywhere except the hero name.

Don't round corners on content. Circles belong only to the WhatsApp float and its pulse ring, the contact buttons and the pointer layer. The 2px focus ring and the 10px scrollbar thumb are the only other exceptions.
Don't add hard, offset or coloured shadows; the two soft drop shadows are the whole vocabulary.
Don't add a second accent hue or a light page ground.
Don't treat mask stops, the hero name's metal stops or the tilt glare as palette colours.
